diagnosis: Customer disputes seat count on invoice; entitlement service unavailable so current seat entitlement cannot be confirmed. Escalation per policy; kb-0018 requires named account owner confirmation for billing/entitlement changes, and kb-0009 details what is needed for an invoice dispute.
reply: Thanks for reaching out. We weren't able to confirm your current seat entitlement from our systems right now, so I can't verify the count on your invoice at this time. To help us review this, please provide the invoice ID, the disputed line item, and the seat count you expected. Disputed invoices are held from collections while under review. Also note that requests affecting billing or entitlements need confirmation from a named account owner on record. I have recommended this ticket for escalation to a specialist.
